title: Control Flow & The ReAct Execution Loop
why: Every autonomous AI agent operates on an iterative while-loop: Thought -> Action -> Observation -> Repeat until goal is achieved or max iterations reached.
objectives: Implement safe while loops with recursion limits
Evaluate LLM stop conditions and tool execution flags
Handle fallback routing when tools fail
concept: Without a hard iteration limiter (max_iterations = 10), an agent with an incorrect prompt can loop infinitely, rapidly draining your API budget and freezing your server.

practice.description: Add an early exit condition that halts the loop if the same tool is called 3 times consecutively with identical arguments.
practice.hint: Track last_tool_call and increment a repeat counter.

requirements: Simulate an agent executing steps until goal state is marked True
Log step timestamps and remaining iteration budget

checklist: Integrated step increment and stop conditions
mistakes: Omitting timeout checks or iteration limits inside autonomous agent loops
